messages:
alex: Quick async check-in — few short notes.

What I did:
- Implemented routing backoff for overflow cases (PR: https://git.redwood/run/routing-backoff)
- Added metrics for kv-cache hit rate and exported to /metrics

Blockers:
- flaky e2e on Dedicated when seq_len > 1024, failing in tokenizer + cache edge-case, need repro and a quick fix

Today:
- Debug e2e with @matt, aim to cut the failing test and push a canary. If someone can approve CR after tests pass, that would help.

Asks:
- @matt can you try to repro on your G4 machine?
- @jen can you tentatively schedule a short postmortem slot if this looks like a regression? :pray:

sam: Thanks, noted. I'll queue a canary window for tonight 10pm PT and created ticket RF-402 to track rollback/playbook updates.

priya: Re: the PR, left a small nit in the diff — need a unit test around cache eviction TTL. I can add the test today.

matt: Happy to reproduce. Starting a local run now, will post logs here. If I get a repro I'll push a debug branch and tag @alex.

jen: FYI ops-bot scheduled a canary for 2026-03-18 02:00 UTC. Also +1 on a retro if severity stays high.

ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary-redwood/route-backoff v2 -> staging at 2026-03-18T02:00:00Z. CI: ✅, Perf smoke: ⏳

alex: @matt — thanks. If you hit the repro, paste the failing command block here so I can run locally. Example command I use:
```
python -m tests.e2e.run --model munchkin-v2 --seq 2048 --runs 5
```
Also I'll add extra logging around kv-cache TTLs and eviction decisions.

matt: repro found — looks like cache eviction path incorrectly handling negative TTLs when sequence length expands. Pushing a small fix to matt/fix-cache-ttl and will open PR momentarily.

priya: I'll add unit + integration tests for TTL edge cases and cover the seq_len expansion scenario. Will link PR once CI passes.

sam: no blockers from PM side. Remind me to demo the routing backoff at next all-hands. :eyes:

jen: Noted. If anyone's on-call tonight please ping #eng-oncall and I'll monitor the canary.

alex: Thanks team. If anyone wants to pair on the tests ping me. I'll plan to close this thread in ~6h unless there are new updates. :wave:
